# Sort load values in descending order

ax5.axhline(y=mean_load, color='green', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7, label=f'Mean: {mean_load:.1f} MW')

ax5.set_title('Load Duration Curve')

# Peak load analysis
